profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Fusionary
profile.summary: I've been working in software development for over 20 years and still love every minute of it!  Most of my experience has been in the agency space where I've been involved in building everything from web applications to complex back end integrations for dozens of companies from many different industries.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States · Hybrid
Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working with clients to design software systems in a variety of areas - specialized business applications, e-commerce, mobile applications for iOS and Android.  Software development in many different languages.  Primarily C# and ASP.NET MVC but also PHP, Java, Objective-C and Cold Fusion.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description: For the last few years I've been in an interesting hybrid role of management and software development.  I've worked as a back-end developer on a number of complex Shopify implementations designing and building middleware solutions to connect Shopify with various ERP and PIM systems using C#, Python & Typescript running primarily in AWS (Lambda & EC2).  I've also been responsible for managing the development staff at CQL, working both with the developers as a mentor and advocate and with the executive & HR team on performance management, training, staffing & hiring.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description: Working with clients, designers and developers to build custom web sites and applications and manage project timelines and estimates.  Primarily worked with the LAMP (Linux, Apache, MySQL & PHP) stack.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a developer on internal business systems, primarily in the procurement and transportation areas.  Built and maintained various intranet applications using Java/J2EE/Oracle and mobile handheld and warehouse systems in C/C++

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained various components of a software package designed to build and deliver customized PDF documents and forms.  Worked primarily in Java and C++
